entry.title: What’s the Tea? Lessons from leaders navigating AI transformation
entry.summary:
I drink a lot of tea. English breakfast, usually, in a real cup, every day. So when my team came to me with an idea for a new series, they wanted it to be relatable, and honestly, I was hesitant at first. But at the end of the day, the name captured something I find genuinely energizing right now: the pace at which leaders are transforming their organizations with AI, and how generously they're sharing what they're learning with one another.
